subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Identifies safe and unsafe situations in the home, at school and in the environment

show.line: Some things are safe and some are not. Let's keep safe at home and school!

rounds.prompt: Which one is unsafe to touch?
rounds.praise: Hot! Never touch a hot pot.

rounds.prompt: Where is the safe place to play?

rounds.praise: A knife is sharp. Only grown-ups use it.

rounds.prompt: You see a broken bottle. What do you do?

rounds.story: Kagiso sees an open bottle of pills on the table. He wants to taste one. What should he do?
rounds.praise: Tell a grown-up! Medicine is not sweets.

hints: Could it hurt you? Then it is unsafe.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will play in a safe place.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I will play ball in the busy road!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The road is unsafe. Play in the park.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Never play in the road. The park is safe!

parent_line: Can tell safe from unsafe situations and knows to tell a grown-up.
